title: used claude opus 5.5 to make a top-down zombie horde game for mobile
author: lorekeeper32

comments.author: lorekeeper32
comments.body:
I was finnally approved by the mods!☺️

This game is inspired by boxhead 2. Old flash game i used to play long ago. The video doesnt do it justice but theres alot of cool things ive added. 140 skins with powers, 50+ relics, random events in waves, and a whole slew of upgrades and pickups and companions and a crazy trader boss and clyde the swords man who spawns randomly to help. Eventually ill add a story too. 

However, i didnt know roguelite was over saturated. I usually play other games, so ive been living under a rock. 

Things i need to change based off feedback: store screenshots, fonts, ui, store description, twin stick controls, better graphics, and something original.
